description: This file contains the implementation of a lexical analyzer (CLexer) for parsing PDF content streams, including token scanning methods for names, numbers, strings, dictionaries, and operators, as well as handling inline images and hexadecimal strings.

classes.name: CLexer
classes.description: A lexical analyzer class for tokenizing PDF content streams, capable of recognizing various token types such as names, numbers, strings, dictionaries, and operators, with support for inline images and hexadecimal strings.

methods.name: ScanNextToken
methods.description: Reads the next token from the PDF content stream and determines its type.

methods.name: ScanComment
methods.description: Skips over comment lines in the content stream.

methods.name: ScanInlineImage
methods.description: Skips over inline image data in the content stream.

methods.name: ScanName
methods.description: Parses a name object starting with '/'.

methods.name: ScanDictionary
methods.description: Parses a dictionary object enclosed in '<<' and '>>'.

methods.name: ScanNumber
methods.description: Parses integer or real number tokens.

methods.name: ScanOperator
methods.description: Parses operator tokens consisting of alphabetic characters and certain symbols.

methods.name: ScanLiteralString
methods.description: Parses literal string objects enclosed in parentheses.

methods.name: ScanHexadecimalString
methods.description: Parses hexadecimal string objects enclosed in '<' and '>'.

methods.name: ScanNextChar
methods.description: Advances the current position by one byte in the content stream and returns the character.

methods.name: AppendAndScanNextChar
methods.description: Appends the current character to the token buffer and advances to the next character.

methods.name: MoveToNonWhiteSpace
methods.description: Advances the cursor to the next non-whitespace character.
